chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The fabricator (of slander) is whipped with a whipping between the two whippings; all of his body is whipped.

key_terms.بَيْنَ الضَّرْبَيْنِ: between the two whippings (referring to the range of 40-80 strikes)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific punishment for a slanderer in Shia jurisprudence according to al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the hadd penalty for the slanderer (al-muftari) as flogging with 39 or 40 strikes, a range derived from the Quranic verse 24:4 which mandates 'ninety' but allows for interpretation in Shia jurisprudence. The emphasis on striking the entire body (jasaduhu kulluhu) distinguishes this penalty from others, ensuring the punishment is comprehensive and visibly deterrent, reflecting the severity of damaging a person's honor (ird).
